reader_summary.overview: Ted is the host of the Capital Allocators podcast and an investment industry expert. It’d been seven years since Ted and I last talked on the record. Now that Ted has a full-time focus on all things Capital Allocators and has stepped away from traditional investing roles.

key_points.text: It’d been seven years since Ted and I last talked on the record.
Now that Ted has a full-time focus on all things Capital Allocators and has stepped away from traditional investing roles.
We discuss the evolution of the LP and GP relationship, the scale of institutional investing, and the nuance of asset allocation, and much more.
